enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn onto right side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Turn onto left side. Stretch legs. Move arm under pillow. Shift body position. Continue sleeping. Turn onto back. Snore softly. Wake briefly. Turn over. Fall back asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Wet face. Apply soap. Rinse face. Turn off faucet. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn on faucet. Rinse toothbrush. Turn off faucet. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Add milk. Stir mixture. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour mixture into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Load plate into dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing bag for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Put on underwear. Close drawer. Pick up bag. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Leave bedroom. Walk to front door. Pick up bag. Open front door. Step outside. Close front door. Lock front door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Enter ward. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Attend morning handover meeting. Review patient charts. Check vital signs. Administer medications. Assist doctors with rounds. Update patient records. Talk to patients. Coordinate with nurses. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Attend afternoon rounds. Respond to patient calls. Clean equipment. End shift. Change out of scrubs. Leave hospital.

Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk home. Arrive home. Unlock front door. Open front door. Enter home. Close front door. Lock front door. Walk to bedroom. Put down bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner, eating, and cleaning up dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Cook meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Pick up plate. Rinse plate. Load plate into dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry with the washing machine and dryer
enriched_activities.desc: Collect dirty clothes. Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Load clothes into washing machine. Add detergent. Close washing machine door. Set washing cycle. Press start button. Wait for wash cycle. Open washing machine door. Transfer clothes to dryer. Close dryer door. Set dryer cycle. Press start button. Wait for dryer cycle. Open dryer door. Take out clothes. Fold clothes. Place clothes in basket.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for personal study and reviewing work notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open computer. Turn on computer. Wait for boot up. Open study materials. Read notes. Type on keyboard. Take notes. Review work notes. Highlight important points. Search online for information. Read article. Type more notes. Save document. Close study materials. Shut down computer. Close computer. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and evening hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Undress. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body and hair. Put on pajamas. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth and spit. Turn off light.

Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn onto right side. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Turn onto left side. Stretch legs. Move arm under pillow. Shift position. Continue sleeping. Turn onto back. Snore softly. Wake briefly. Turn over. Fall back asleep.
